description: Compute a TPO (Time Price Opportunity) Market Profile from caller-supplied bracket high/low price pairs using the MyPivots Market Profile calculator. Pass brackets in chronological order (minimum 2, maximum 1000): each bracket represents one time period and is assigned a sequential TPO letter starting from startingLetter (default "D", index 19 in the 48-letter Market Profile bracket sequence) across every price tick from its low to its high. Optional settings default to tickSize 0.25, valueAreaPercent 70, startingLetter "D", and decimalPlaces 2 (decimal prices only; bond fraction formats are not supported). Returns a text-only report containing a summary block — Point of Control (POC, the price level with the most TPOs nearest the profile center), Value Area High (VAH) and Value Area Low (VAL, enclosing the target valueAreaPercent of total TPOs), bracket count, and total TPO count — followed by the monospace TPO profile grid ordered from highest price to lowest price with visible markers for Value Area membership ("|") and [VAH], [POC], and [VAL] rows. Calculator-level validation messages (such as a low above a high or a profile exceeding the 2000-tick width cap) return as a text result carrying the calculator message rather than failing the call; schema violations (bad types, unknown properties, out-of-range bracket counts, invalid startingLetter, or out-of-range parameters) fail with an error and return nothing. This tool is a pure calculator over prices you supply: it does not fetch market data, historical bars, real-time quotes, forecasts, or execute trades. Calls require a free MyPivots account (sign in via OAuth or personal API token); no Premium subscription is required.

brackets.description: Chronological array of Market Profile brackets (time periods), each with decimal high and low prices. Minimum 2, maximum 1000.

high.description: High price for this bracket (decimal number).

low.description: Low price for this bracket (decimal number).

decimalPlaces.description: Optional number of decimal places (0 to 9) for formatted price labels in the summary and grid. Defaults to 2.

startingLetter.description: Optional single TPO letter assigned to the first bracket from the 48-letter Market Profile sequence (i..z, A..Z, a..h, omitting O, U, o, u). Subsequent brackets advance sequentially and wrap around. Defaults to "D".

tickSize.description: Optional minimum price increment (tick size, must be greater than 0). Defaults to 0.25.

valueAreaPercent.description: Optional target percentage of total TPOs enclosed in the Value Area (0 to 100). Defaults to 70.
